citations.text: The primary endpoint was an ordinal outcome based on the patient's clinical status on day 7 (appendix p 14).
The seven categories of this outcome ranged from return to usual activities with no more than minimal symptoms due to COVID-19, to death.
A proportional odds model was used to compare the primary ordinal outcome at day 7.
The day 7 primary outcome was imputed for participants for whom this information was missing (appendix p 20).

The composite safety outcome at day 28 was summarised with hazard ratios (HRs) estimated from a proportional hazards model adjusted for baseline ordinal outcome category and hIVIG product provided to the site.
